notes:
Her replies on Discord and Bluesky are no longer held back for sounding like something noted about someone.

- **No more echo check on her replies there.** Before, a reply that shared two telling words with anything noted about you or your people, like "the cello" or "moving in March", was held back with "it echoed something about someone you talk with", even when she only said it back to the person who brought it up. Those notes were never in her prompt there, so the check mostly caught ordinary replies.
- A reply that names someone you talk with is still held back (your own name is fine to your linked Discord account), and so is one with a link or a secret.
- Her free-time searches and notes keep the echo check, so nothing noted about your people goes to a search engine.
